name: Dawn Orchard
scene: DAWN ORCHARD: rows of gnarled apple trees with red fruit and soft sage leaves behind low dry-stone walls. Old pale-stone cider press house offset to the left with reddish roof, stacked empty wooden apple crates far behind lane, distant farmhouse and rolling misty pasture. Pale peach dawn through stepped rose/cream clouds, cool lavender shadows, dew on restrained grass. Broad level ochre farm track in foreground. The orchard, cider house and pale dawn should dominate.

name: Stormwind Mill
scene: STORMWIND MILL: towering weathered timber windmill on a pale stone base offset right, with big four-blade silhouette, old grain barn left, golden wheat fields, broken stone tower far distance. Dramatic indigo storm clouds with a thin copper break of sunlight, cool slate/teal shadows and warm gold grain. Fence line and wheat remain BEHIND the lane. Broad level firm gravel mill yard across foreground, no puddles or raised objects in lane. No animated rain overlay; one richly crafted still.

name: Moonlit Creek Crossing
scene: MOONLIT CREEK CROSSING: small arched stone bridge and calm silver-blue creek in middle background, willow trees and reeds only behind the lane, lantern-lit pale stone watermill cottage left, turning waterwheel attached beside creek in background, distant red-roof farmhouse and ruined chimney on ridge. Crescent moon and crisp stepped midnight blue clouds, localized amber lantern light, blue/sage/silver palette. A broad continuous flat dry compacted earth towpath across foreground in FRONT of all creek water; no water crosses the fighting lane. No bridge arch under fighters.
